model: Export residential split air conditioners (built-in Modbus on indoor unit / wired controller)
equipment_type: Split AC unit (VRF / split AC gateway built in)
applies_to: Gree export residential air conditioners whose indoor-unit controller or wired controller has the integrated Modbus RTU interface; protocol PDF dated 2023-05.
summary: On these Gree residential units the Modbus RTU slave lives in the indoor-unit controller or wired controller, so no extra module is needed. Holding registers carry on/off, mode, fan speed, setpoint, louvres, sleep and energy-saving limits plus indoor, return-air and outdoor temperatures; coils carry feature flags, locks and a long list of indoor, outdoor and inverter-drive fault bits. Up to 255 units can share one BMS line.

addressing.note: Registers are words numbered from 0 and coils are bits numbered from 0 (Bit0 = Byte0.0). Word n is wire address n and Bit n is coil n. The example frames agree: reading ten bits from coil 5 sends start address 00 05, and reading two words from address 1 sends 00 01.

source.title: Modbus Protocol for export residential air conditioners
source.pages: p. 7 serial settings, pp. 8-12 coil/word layout and example frames, pp. 13-14 precautions, pp. 14-19 words, pp. 20-27 bits

notes: Gree does not host this protocol publicly; the link is the unaltered Gree PDF in the product-document store of the Finnish wholesaler Onninen (Kesko). No document number is printed; the date is the PDF creation date.
Registers are read with function 03 and written with 16; coils are read with 01 and written with 15. Points marked R in the table are read-only.
Only named points are listed; reserved words and bits are left out. Bits 237-239 have no name in the table and are left out.
Mode and swing values are printed in binary in the source (for example 001 = cooling, 1011 = swing positions 1-3); they are given here as decimal.
Left/right swing value 1100 (12) is printed only as '15 position'; the manual does not explain it, so the label is kept as printed.
The outdoor-ambient range is printed as -100 to 155 in whole degrees and is listed as a signed 16-bit value as the table states.
Several fault and status bits apply only to units that have that function (fresh-air valve, gate control, card switch, DRED).

integration.summary: Poll words 2-25 for on/off, mode, fan, setpoint and louvres and words 4, 49 and 82 for temperatures; read coils 17-236 for status and fault bits. Write word 2 (0xAA on / 0x55 off), 17, 19 and 20 to control the unit.
integration.enable: The Modbus interface is built into the indoor-unit controller or wired controller; each unit needs its own address (1-255) set before connecting the BMS. Power-cycle the unit after connecting the controller.
quirks: The two energy-saving flags (bits 32 and 33) must be set or cleared together.
A setpoint outside the active energy-saving limit is silently ignored; check by reading back.
Exception code 03 is returned for an out-of-range read (for example 128 words; the maximum is 127 per request).
setup: RS485, 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
Use twisted pair kept at least 15 cm from power cables; repeaters may be needed on long lines.
Match A to A and B to B; a constantly lit TX lamp on the converter points to swapped A/B.
gotchas: Sleep is ignored in fan and auto modes.
The remote temperature shield is ignored in auto mode unless the unit allows setpoint adjustment in auto (bit 75).
Heating commands to cooling-only units (bit 177 = 1) do nothing.
